source_title: India vs New Zealand 4th T20I: Match Date, Time, Venue & Live Streaming Details
source_excerpt:
IND vs NZ 4th T20I : India will face New Zealand in the fourth T20I of the five-match series on Friday, October 30, 2026. The match will be played at Eden Park in Auckland, with the two teams set to return to action after India's series-clinching performances in the opening three matches. Although India have already secured the series, the upcoming encounter will give the visitors a chance to extend their winning run. New Zealand, meanwhile, will look to bounce back on home soil and avoid another defeat.
The fourth T20I between India and New Zealand is scheduled to take place on Friday, October 30, 2026.
The match will be held at Eden Park in Auckland, New Zealand.

The match is scheduled to begin at 12:30 PM IST, with the toss expected at 12:00 PM IST. In New Zealand, the game is scheduled to start at 8:00 PM local time.
Cricket fans in India can tune into Sony Sports Network TV channels for the live broadcast of IND vs NZ 4th T20I.
As for live streaming, the match will be available online through the SonyLIV app and website in India.
Viewers should note that a paid subscription is mandatory to watch the full India vs New Zealand fixture on this platform.
India head into the match having already clinched the five-match series after winning the first three T20Is.
With that in mind, the Men in Blue might make a few changes to their playing XI, giving opportunities to players who are yet to feature without any risks the series outcome.
New Zealand, meanwhile, could be equally determined to put up a strong fight and end their winless run against India on home soil.
